$comment: The one fill vocabulary every pre-made agency site uses. A company's values object has these keys, so it fills any of the 30 designs. Lists have a fixed length, except the optional ones, which hold up to `maxItems` and may be empty or absent.

tagline.description: One short positioning line for the hero.

intro.description: One or two sentences: what the agency does and for whom (setup answer `about`).

audience.description: Who and where it serves: locations, levels, industries (setup answer `markets`).

pricing_note.description: How it charges, in the owner's words (setup answer `offer`). No invented figures.

city.description: Home city, shown in the footer and contact block.

form_action.description: Where the shared contact form (`form.html`) posts: the platform's form address for the live site, or empty for no form (the mailto: links stay). Only ever inside {{#if form_action}}.

services.description: What the agency sells, as four offers.

specialties.description: Six short labels: the roles, channels or disciplines it covers.

process.description: How an engagement runs, in three steps.

proof.description: Company-supplied proof: a result, a quote or a fact, with an optional source. Never invented. Every use sits inside {{#if proof[i]}} (and {{#if proof[i].source}}).

logos.description: Company-supplied client names, set as text. Every use sits inside {{#if logos[i]}}.
